But taste buds don’t lie, there was something off about the German labelled product that was simply unpalatable, to the point where I couldn’t even finish half a bottle of it. It was that bad. 

If Huel can address those problems, I’d definitely come back. But £200 is a lot of fork out on food that could potentially taste so bad that you don’t even consume it. The replacements basically turned my house into a warehouse of boxes of stuff that I couldn’t drink. 

Some of the best customer service in the game though. Great products that taste good when they’re good. Just a shame really. It needs looking at, because shifting logistics around to get rid of older RTD is no good when it causes you to haemorrhage customers.
